transcript.statement: As SafetyAgent, I assert that the requirements SAF-01 to SAF-07 are essential for ensuring the safety and reliability of the attendance tracking system. requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and encrypt all student attendance data at rest and in transit.
The system shall provide automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting and maintain audit logs of all access and modifications.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis and comply with regulations.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access, combining user roles and logging.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization while ensuring efficiency.
